TOKEN_INVALID: Session expired, please sign in again
SESSION_REPLACED: This account signed in on another page; this page has been signed out
MES_NO_PAGE_LOGIN: MES interface accounts cannot sign in to pages
PASSWORD_CHANGED: Your password was changed or reset: please sign in again with the new password
FORBIDDEN: Your role is not allowed to do this
FACTORY_FORBIDDEN: You can only operate data of your authorized production orgs: {factory}
USER_NO_FACTORY: This account is not authorized for any production org; please contact the system administrator
CONFLICT_RETRY: Data is being changed by another operation, please retry
PI_BUSY: PI {pi} is busy with another operation (generate, revoke, allocate or transfer), please retry later
USER_EMP_NO_INVALID: Employee No. must be 4–32 letters and digits
USER_NAME_REQUIRED: Name is required, at most 64 characters
USER_ROLE_FIXED: MES interface accounts and page accounts cannot switch roles with each other
USER_FACTORY_REQUIRED: Operators and auditors must be authorized for at least one production org
USER_MES_FACTORY_REQUIRED: MES interface accounts must be bound to one production org
USER_ADMIN_NO_FACTORY: The system administrator is not bound to a production org
USER_ADMIN_UNIQUE: There is only one system administrator: you cannot create one or change an account into one
USER_PASSWORD_WEAK: Password must be 8–64 characters containing both letters and digits; only letters, digits and ! {'@'} # $ & * are allowed
USER_PASSWORD_SAME: New password must differ from the current one
USER_SELF_DISABLE: You cannot disable your own account
USER_SELF_DELETE: You cannot delete your own account
USER_LAST_ADMIN: At least one enabled administrator must remain
USER_MANAGE_FORBIDDEN: Only the system administrator can manage accounts
USER_SUPER_ADMIN_FIXED: The system administrator must stay enabled; its role cannot change and it cannot be disabled or deleted
USER_NOT_MES: This account is not an MES interface account
USER_SECRET_UNAVAILABLE: The secret of this account cannot be viewed (SN_SECRET was changed, or the account predates viewable secrets); please reset the secret
FACTORY_DISABLED: Production org {factory} is disabled in Kingdee
MES_TEST_REQUIRED: “MES integration” can be enabled only after the URL and credential are filled in and the connection test passes
MES_DISABLE_BLOCKED: Production org {factory} still has unfinished pushes: {detail}; resume them, wait for MES receipts, or have HQ confirm / void manually
MES_NOT_ENABLED: Production org {factory} does not have “MES integration” enabled
ORDER_NOT_FOUND: Production order {bill_no} is not in the snapshot (not approved, or not synced yet)
ORDER_LINE_NOT_FOUND: Material line {bill_no} / {seq} is not in the snapshot
ORDER_SYNC_BUSY: Order sync is running, please retry later
ATTACH_INVALID: Attachment item cannot be empty and must be at most 64 characters
ATTACH_FILL_K3: Kingdee already has the attachment item; it cannot be changed on the page
LENGTH_FILL_INVALID: Length must be at most 64 characters and cannot be empty when set in batch
LENGTH_FILL_CHINESE: Length {value} contains Chinese characters; change it to a length without Chinese
UNIT_FILL_INVALID: Unit must be at most 64 characters
UNIT_FILL_CHINESE: Unit {value} contains Chinese characters; enter a unit without Chinese (e.g. M, m, L)
LINE_EDIT_GENERATED: Material line {bill_no} / {seq} already has SNs; attachment item, length and unit cannot be changed. While the SNs are unallocated, revoke the generation first
LINE_EDIT_ALLOCATED: SNs of material line {bill_no} / {seq} are allocated; attachment item, length and unit can no longer be changed
ALERT_NOT_FOUND: Order change alert not found or already handled
ALERT_ACTION_INVALID: This alert cannot be handled this way
ALERT_MAP_TARGET_INVALID: The target material line must be another line of this bill in the snapshot: {seq}
ALERT_MAP_FROZEN: {count} SNs of the lost material line are in unconfirmed or failed batches; confirm the mapping after those batches are confirmed
RULE_CODE_INVALID: Rule code must be 1–64 letters, digits, _ or -
RULE_NAME_REQUIRED: Rule name is required, at most 128 characters
RULE_CATEGORY_INVALID: Category must be Uncategorized, Customer or PI
RULE_CATEGORY_REQUIRED: For Customer or PI category, fill in the customer or PI (at most 64 characters)
RULE_IN_USE: Rule {rule_code} has generated SNs and cannot be deleted
RULE_ASSIGNED: Rule {rule_code} is assigned to PI {pi} and cannot be deleted
RULE_AFFIX_INVALID: The separators before and after the length may each have at most 16 characters
RULE_LENGTH_PAD_INVALID: Length zero-padding must be 0–32 digits (0 = no padding)
RULE_PREFIX_CONFLICT: Prefix {prefix} is already used by rule {rule_name} version {version}; SNs would collide
RULE_CHARSET_LENGTH: Charset length must equal the base
RULE_CHARSET_DUPLICATE: Charset must not contain duplicate characters
RULE_SN_TOO_LONG: Prefix + serial + separators + length + unit + suffix must not exceed 64 characters
RULE_USED_FORMAT: Version {version} has generated SNs; to change the format, create a new version with a new prefix
RULE_PREFIX_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Rule {rule_code} version {version} is already used by PI {other_pi}; enter a new prefix for this PI
RULE_CUSTOMER_BOUND: Customer {customer} is already bound to rule {rule_code}
RULE_GLOBAL_READONLY: Only the system administrator can modify or delete global rules: {rule_code}
RULE_FACTORY_REQUIRED: Please choose the production org the rule belongs to
GEN_SCOPE_INVALID: Generation scope must be bills or material lines under the same PI
GEN_NOT_GENERATABLE: The selected scope cannot be generated: {detail}
GEN_PI_QUOTA_EMPTY: The selected scope has no quota left to generate
GEN_RULE_EXHAUSTED: Rule digits exhausted: max serial {max}, this run needs up to {end}
GEN_PREVIEW_REQUIRED: Run the preview first before generating
GEN_PREVIEW_CHANGED: Preview conditions changed, please preview again
GEN_PREVIEW_STALE: Max SN of PI {pi} changed from {expected} to {actual}; preview is stale, please preview again
GEN_PREVIEW_USED: This preview was already used for a generation, please preview again
GEN_BUSY: PI {pi} is generating, please retry later
GEN_DUPLICATE_SN: Full SN {sn} duplicates an existing SN of PI {pi}; the whole generation was rolled back (no auto-skip)
GEN_REVOKE_NOT_SUCCESS: Only successful generations can be revoked
GEN_REVOKE_NOT_LAST: Only the material line last in PI {pi}'s serial can be revoked; revoke line by line from the end
GEN_REVOKE_LINE_INVALID: This material line is not in the generation, or was already revoked
GEN_REVOKE_ALLOCATED: {count} of the SNs to revoke have been allocated or transferred; they cannot be revoked
GEN_QTY_OVER_MAX: At most {max} SNs per generation, the selected lines total {qty}; select fewer lines per run, or contact the administrator
GEN_CANCELED: Generation canceled; all written SNs were deleted
GEN_CANCEL_NOT_RUNNING: This generation has already finished and cannot be canceled
ALLOC_NOTHING: No SNs to allocate in the selected scope
PUSH_NOTHING: Production org {factory} has no SNs or batches of PI {pi} to push
BATCH_NOT_PENDING: Batch {batch_no} is already {result} and cannot be handled again
BATCH_NOT_VOIDABLE: Batch {batch_no} was already processed by MES (receipt or content mismatch); it cannot be voided, only fixed by an MES receipt correction or confirmed manually
BATCH_BASIS_REQUIRED: A basis is required (e.g. written confirmation from MES, at most 500 characters)
DALERT_NOT_FOUND: Delivery alert not found or already handled
DALERT_RESEND_BLOCKED: SN {sn} cannot be re-pushed based on this system: {detail}
ACQ_BATCH_INCOMPLETE: Acquire batch {batch_no} is incomplete and cannot be downloaded
EXPORT_NOTHING: Bill {bill_no} of PI {pi} has no allocated SNs
TR_SCOPE_INVALID: Transfer scope must be a whole bill, bill + material, or a single SN / contiguous range
TR_MATERIAL_REQUIRED: Material code is required when transferring by material or by range
TR_SN_REQUIRED: Start SN is required for a range transfer (start only = single SN)
TR_TARGET_PI_MISMATCH: Target bill {bill_no} belongs to PI {pi}, not the target PI entered
TR_TARGET_ORG_MISMATCH: For a bill transfer the target org must be the org of target bill {bill_no}: {factory}
TR_NOTHING: No transferable SNs in the selected scope
TR_SAME_TARGET: Target is identical to the source
TR_NOT_PENDING: Org transfer request {transfer_no} has already been handled
TR_TARGET_DISABLED: Target production org {factory} is disabled in Kingdee and cannot be confirmed
TR_WITHDRAW_FORBIDDEN: You can only withdraw requests submitted by your authorized orgs
TR_CONCURRENT: Some SNs just changed status, please refresh and retry
TR_LENGTH_MISMATCH: Target material length {target} differs from the length {current} on the SN; cannot transfer
TR_TARGET_BILL_INVALID: Target bill {bill_no} must be in the snapshot with a PI; for a bill transfer it must differ from the source bill
TR_TARGET_LINE_REQUIRED: Target bill {bill_no} has several lines of material {material}; choose the target line
TR_TARGET_LINE_INVALID: Target material line {seq} is not in the target bill
TR_RANGE_INVALID: Range {start_sn} ~ {end_sn} is not within the selected bill and material, or spans different serial PIs
QUERY_PI_REQUIRED: A PI is required to view SNs of the same PI across production orgs
QUERY_PI_NOT_OWNED: Your production org has no SNs of PI {pi}; other orgs cannot be viewed
QUERY_RANGE_PI_REQUIRED: A PI is required when querying by serial range
QUERY_RANGE_INVALID: {value} is not a serial or full SN of PI {pi}
QUERY_RANGE_REVERSED: Start serial {start} is greater than end serial {end}
EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: At most {max} rows per export; please narrow the filters
